docs.text: EX-99.1 2 ex99-1.htm EX-99.1 Exhibit 99.1 Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR) Announces ETH Holdings Reach 6.07 Million Tokens, and Total Crypto and Total Cash & Marketable Securities Holdings of $14.3 Billion Bitmine owns 4.97% of the total ETH coin supply of 122.2 million Vitalik Buterin, founder of Ethereum, states "I’ve finally made up my mind, ETH is a store of value, ETH is money" Bitmine is 99% of the way to the ‘Alchemy of 5%’ in just 15 months Bitmine released Chairman’s Message on October 7 titled "Crypto Bull Underway — This Cycle Likely the Largest" Bitmine was added to the Russell 1000 Large-cap index on June 26, 2026 Bitmine’s Series A Preferred Stock is trading on the NYSE under the symbol BMNP Bitmine has 5,227,037 staked ETH, representing $11.7 billion at $2,234 per ETH. ("Bitmine" or the "Company"), a Bitcoin and Ethereum Network company with a focus on the accumulation of crypto for long term investment, today announced Bitmine crypto + total cash & marketable securities + "moonshots" holdings totaling $14.3 billion. As of November 8, 2026 at 2:00pm ET, the Company’s crypto holdings are comprised of 6,070,092 ETH at $2,234 per ETH (per Coinbase NASDAQ: COIN), 216 Bitcoin (BTC), $180 million stake in Beast Industries, $75 million stake in Eightco Holdings (NASDAQ: ORBS) ("moonshots") and total cash & marketable securities of $475 million. Bitmine’s ETH holdings are 4.97% of the ETH supply (of 122.2 million ETH). "Vitalik Buterin, founder of Ethereum, declared at Devcon 8 in Mumbai, ‘I’ve finally made up my mind, ETH is a store of value, ETH is money.’ This declaration by the founder of Ethereum, in my view, is a seismic shift, clarifying how ETH will capture value in this coming supercycle of tokenization and AI," stated Thomas "Tom" Lee, Chairman of Bitmine. "In my opinion, ETH was not a ‘cash flow’ token model, like HYPE or LIT, but rather pristine and trusted collateral, and reflective of how Ethereum is the Layer 1 chosen by the vast majority of financial institutions moving assets onto the blockchain," continued Lee. Vitalik further clarified his views with a X.com post (link here) expanding on why he believes "ETH as store of value (SoV)." The 3 reasons he described: 1. ETH as fee-burning is not as strong "as it seemed;" 2. Optimizing for fee-burning is not necessarily compatible with decentralization and capture resistance; and 3. Optimizing for SoV aligns with ETH’s strengths of decentralization and CROPS. "In other words, ETH as a Store of Value is most consistent with the future roadmap of ETH and also the role ETH will play in the coming super tokenization supercycle," added Lee. Source: X.com Source: X.com "Over the past week, we acquired 9,587 ETH. Bitmine’s track record of consistent buying of crypto is unmatched by any public company in the world. Bitmine has bought ETH each week since the inception of the ETH Treasury Strategy on June 30, 2025," stated Lee. On October 7, Bitmine released its latest Chairman’s message titled "Crypto Bull Underway — This Cycle Likely the Largest." The presentation is available at the Bitmine website ( presentation link ). Earlier in 2026, Bitmine launched MAVAN (the Made in America VAlidator Network), the institutional-grade staking platform. While MAVAN was originally developed to support Bitmine’s own Ethereum treasury, MAVAN has expanded to serve institutional investors, custodians, and ecosystem partners seeking best-in-class staking infrastructure. A portion of Bitmine’s ETH is already staked on the MAVAN platform. As of November 8, 2026, Bitmine total staked ETH stands at 5,227,037 ($11.7 billion at $2,234 per ETH). "Bitmine has staked more ETH than other entities in the world. At scale (when Bitmine’s ETH is fully staked by MAVAN and its staking partners), the projected ETH staking rewards would be $359 million on an annualized basis, using BMNR’s trailing 7-day staking yield of 2.65% as of November 8, 2026. This compares to annualized staking rewards of $309 million based upon 5.2 million staked ETH (86% of the 6.07 million ETH held by Bitmine)," continued Lee. Bitmine’s crypto holdings reign as the #1 Ethereum treasury and #2 global treasury, behind Strategy Inc. (NASDAQ: MSTR), which reportedly owns 849,327 BTC valued at approximately $69 billion. Bitmine remains the largest ETH treasury in the world. Bitmine management believes the GENIUS Act and the Securities and Exchange Commission’s (SEC) Project Crypto are as transformational to financial services in 2026 as the U.S. action on August 15, 1971, which ended the Bretton Woods system and took the U.S. dollar off the gold standard 55 years ago. This 1971 event was the catalyst for the modernization of Wall Street, creating the iconic Wall Street titans and financial and payment rails of today. ("Bitmine" or the "Company"), a Bitcoin and Ethereum Network company with a focus on the accumulation of crypto for long term investment, today announced Bitmine crypto + total cash & marketable securities + "moonshots" holdings totaling $14.5 billion. According to reports by Binance and other media sources, the exploit stems from an infiltration of a contractor into Binance’s corporate infrastructure. The FBI has named North Korea (DPRK) as the perpetrator. While this is a terrible development, in my view, the relatively muted crypto market reaction is very constructive, particularly compared to the market’s response to prior sizable crypto thefts," stated Thomas "Tom" Lee, Chairman of Bitmine. "In February 2025, ByBit was also hacked by DPRK (with a very different methodology) and $1.5 billion of customer crypto was stolen. The day the ByBit theft was announced, ETH fell 8% and was down 20% within a week. By contrast, since the Binance theft was disclosed, ETH went down 4%. We believe this is a far more muted market reaction despite the size of the theft being approximately quadruple the size," continued Lee. "We believe there are 6 reasons that explain why the Binance theft has a muted market reaction. These are: 1. Binance has the financial capabilities to cover all customer losses. 2. There was not a ‘cascade’ of Defi protocol failures, as was seen post-ByBit theft. 3. Swift industry action cut potential loss by 50%. 4. FBI named North Korea (DPRK) as the responsible party within 2 days of the theft. Historically, authorities have taken as long as 180 days to name DPRK in prior heists. 5. Exploit was a "corporate infiltration" of Binance infrastructure and not a blockchain exploit. 6. Limited price downside is a sign that a crypto "bull market" is underway, notwithstanding recent price declines. And taken altogether, we believe this is a sign that the crypto industry is increasingly resilient and more capable of absorbing these nation-state assaults on financial infrastructure," stated Lee. "Over the past week, we acquired 8,573 ETH. Bitmine’s track record of consistent buying of crypto is unmatched by any public company in the world. Bitmine has bought ETH each week since the inception of the ETH Treasury Strategy on June 30, 2025," stated Lee. Reports Strong Q3 2026 Results; NAV per Share More Than Quadruples and SOL per Share Grows Over 20% BOCA RATON, FL — November 12, 2026 — DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV) (the "Company" or "DeFi Dev Corp."), the first U.S. public company with a treasury strategy built to accumulate and compound Solana ("SOL"), today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and released its quarterly shareholder letter. Shareholder Letter Highlights ● SOL per share ("SPS") increased more than 20% from August 12 through September 30. 2026. ● Net asset value ("NAV") per share more than quadrupled over the same period, increasing over 300% from August 12 through September 30, 2026. ● Total SOL and SOL equivalents increased to 2,549,137 at September 30, up approximately 10% from the August 12 earnings update. ● SOL-denominated borrowings declined approximately 13%, from 562,000 SOL on August 12 to 487,000 SOL on September 30. ● Cash, cash equivalents, stablecoins, and marketable securities more than doubled from June 30 to September 30, strengthening the Company’s flexibility to fund operations and pursue treasury growth. ● Launched CHAD (Nasdaq: CHAD) , establishing a perpetual source of capital intended to grow SOL holdings without issuing common shares, with no stated maturity or scheduled principal repayment. Recent Developments ● CHAD first closed at its $10 stated amount ("par") just 48 calendar days after its trading debut, faster than either Strive’s SATA or Strategy’s STRC, measured from trading debut to the first closing price at or above par. ● CHAD’s annual dividend rate increased to 14% , effective November 2, with daily cash dividends when declared. The Company is focused on broadening CHAD’s investor base, deepening liquidity, and scaling issuance on attractive terms. ● Total SOL and SOL equivalents reached 2,609,829 as of November 9, up approximately 13% from August 12, following nine consecutive weeks of SOL purchases. Read the Shareholder Letter The full Q3 2026 Shareholder Letter, including financial results, treasury strategy, CHAD credit metrics, and calculation methodologies, is available at: https://defidevcorp.com/earnings . Management’s business update video will be available at approximately 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time on November 12, 2026, at youtube.com/@DeFiDevCorp , addressing strategic highlights and questions submitted by shareholders and sell-side analysts. Through this strategy, the Company provides investors with direct economic exposure to SOL, while also actively participating in the growth of the Solana ecosystem. In addition to holding and staking SOL, DeFi Development Corp. operates its own validator infrastructure, generating staking rewards and fees from delegated stake. The Company is also engaged across decentralized finance (DeFi) opportunities and continues to explore innovative ways to support and benefit from Solana’s expanding application layer. The Company is also an AI-powered online platform that connects the commercial real estate industry by providing value-add services and software subscriptions to multifamily and commercial property professionals, as the Company connects the increasingly complex ecosystem that stakeholders have to manage. Increases SOL Treasury to 2.61 Million Company Adds 8,881 SOL and SOL Equivalents, Marking Nine Consecutive Weeks of SOL Purchases CHAD's 14.00% annual dividend rate continues to offer one of the most competitive income opportunities in digital credit BOCA RATON, FL — November 9, 2026 — DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV) (the "Company" or "DeFi Dev Corp."), the first U.S. public company with a treasury strategy built to accumulate and compound Solana ("SOL"), today announced that its total holdings of SOL and SOL equivalents increased by 8,881 SOL since its last update, bringing its treasury to approximately 2,609,829 SOL, up from 2,600,948 SOL. The increase marks the Company's ninth consecutive week of SOL purchases since September 14, 2026, building on its return to active accumulation on August 27. The continued purchases reflect the Company's continued execution of its treasury strategy, focused on growing SOL holdings and increasing SOL per share ("SPS") over time. "Our strategy remains consistent: accumulate SOL, compound our holdings, and grow SOL per share," said Joseph Onorati, Chief Executive Officer of DeFi Development Corp. "We remain focused on disciplined execution and positioning the Company to create long-term shareholder value as the Solana ecosystem continues to develop." CHAD Continues to Offer One of the Highest Dividend Rates in Digital Credit DeFi Development Corp.'s Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock (Nasdaq: CHAD) continues to offer a 14.00% annualized dividend rate, among the highest in the digital credit market. Based on its $10.00 stated amount, CHAD's 14.00% annualized dividend rate equates to $1.40 per share annually. Dividends are cumulative and payable each business day when, as and if declared by the Company's Board of Directors. CHAD offers income-focused investors a differentiated way to participate in the Company's SOL treasury strategy. Unlike traditional corporate treasuries, which typically hold cash and other low-yielding assets, DeFi Development Corp.'s SOL holdings can generate recurring income through native staking and validator operations. The Company believes this productive treasury provides a strong foundation for scaling its digital credit offerings. "CHAD combines a 14% annualized dividend rate with a treasury of productive SOL assets, creating what we believe is a compelling proposition for income-focused investors," said Onorati. "As we grow CHAD, our objective is to expand our capacity to accumulate SOL while continuing to drive long-term SOL per share growth for common shareholders." The Company intends to continue growing CHAD as a core component of its long-term capital strategy, providing income-focused investors with an alternative to common equity while supporting continued SOL accumulation. Learn more about CHAD at www.defidevcorp.com/chad . For more information, visit defidevcorp.com . To stay up to date with the latest developments and insights, subscribe to our blog . About DeFi Development Corp. DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV) has adopted a treasury policy under which the principal holding in its treasury reserve is allocated to SOL. Through this strategy, the Company provides investors with direct economic exposure to SOL, while also actively participating in the growth of the Solana ecosystem. In addition to holding and staking SOL, DeFi Development Corp. operates its own validator infrastructure, generating staking rewards and fees from delegated stake. The Company is also engaged across decentralized finance (DeFi) opportunities and continues to explore innovative ways to support and benefit from Solana’s expanding application layer. The Company is also an AI-powered online platform that connects the commercial real estate industry by providing value-add services and software subscriptions to multifamily and commercial property professionals, as the Company connects the increasingly complex ecosystem that stakeholders have to manage. The Company’s data and software offerings are generally offered on a subscription basis as software as a service.
